name: Hong Kong Baptist University
summary: Kowloon Tong liberal arts university with 23 undergraduate programmes and over 40 majors; the middle half of 2026 IB entrants had 30-34 points.

ib.text: No minimum total is set; the middle half of 2026 entrants had 30-34 points. IB English A grade 4 (English B: 4 at HL, 5 at SL). Chinese Medicine also asks for Biology or Chemistry and a Chinese qualification.

dates.label: First round: applications close, 11:59 pm Hong Kong time
Main round: applications close, 11:59 pm Hong Kong time
Extended round: applications close, 11:59 pm Hong Kong time

programmes.name: Communication (Journalism, PR and Advertising)
programmes.about: One broad-based entry into two majors, Journalism and Digital Media or Public Relations and Advertising. The journalism side offers Chinese, international, broadcast and financial specialisms, plus a data and media concentration.
programmes.ib: The general IB rules apply: English A grade 4 (English B 4 at HL, 5 at SL); no subject is required.

needs.note: English B: grade 4 at HL or 5 at SL

programmes.selectionNote: Majors are allocated in year one on your results, a core-subject score, your preference and the School's allocation.

flagshipSource.title: School of Communication: Journalism and Digital Media and Public Relations and Advertising majors (programme page)

programmes.name: Chinese Medicine and Biomedical Science
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Chinese Medicine and BSc
programmes.about: A six-year double degree combining Chinese medicine, biomedical and clinical Western medicine and university-wide courses, with a 15-month internship and an honours project. Some courses are taught in Putonghua or Cantonese.
programmes.ib: Biology or Chemistry and a Chinese qualification (IB Chinese A grade 5 at HL or 6 at SL, or Chinese B grade 7 at HL). International applicants cannot list it as a second choice.

needs.note: A recognised result in Biology or Chemistry

programmes.selectionNote: The programme office will not consider non-local applicants who name it as a second choice.

flagshipSource.title: Chinese Medicine and Biomedical Science: a six-year double degree funded by the UGC (programme page)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in Film and Television
programmes.about: A four-year film and television degree in the School of Creative Arts with a small first-year intake of 18 students; classes are taught in English.
programmes.ib: The general IB rules apply: English A grade 4 (English B 4 at HL, 5 at SL). International applicants cannot list it as a second choice.
programmes.selectionNote: Only one choice counts: the programme office will not consider non-local applicants who name it as a second choice.

flagshipSource.title: School of Creative Arts: Film and Television, a small cohort in a creative-arts school (programme page)

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Broad-based entry: pick the faculty, then choose your major after year one; the general IB rules apply.

faculties.name: School of Business
faculties.line: Business Administration, with an Accounting Concentration entry; the general IB rules apply.

faculties.name: School of Chinese Medicine
faculties.line: Biology or Chemistry and a Chinese language qualification are expected; Putonghua or Cantonese is used in some courses.

faculties.name: School of Communication
faculties.line: Broad-based entry into journalism, public relations and advertising; game design and animation is a separate entry.

faculties.name: School of Creative Arts
faculties.line: Music asks for ABRSM Grade 8 practical (or equal), Grade 5 theory and a portfolio; Creative Industries asks for a portfolio.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Technology
faculties.line: Broad-based entry to the BSc, plus a BSc in Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence; the general IB rules apply.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local tuition for 2027/28 is HK$240,000 a year.
You must authorise the IB to release your actual scores to HKBU (institution code 000247) so it can verify them before admission.
Applicants without a first-round offer are considered together with main-round applicants.
